description:
CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance: DecodeNumberField() calls strcpy(fstr, cp + 1) and then appends "000000" into the fixed-size stack buffer fstr[MAXDATELEN + 1] without checking the input length, so a long fractional-second string overflows the stack buffer.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance: EluPrepare uses GetInput/GetOutput without checking the result, so a model with an optional or invalid tensor index makes input (or output) nullptr, which is then dereferenced via input->type.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance: In parse_exif() the tag 0x927c RaspberryPi branch calls fgets(mn_text, len, ifp) with the untrusted EXIF len and no limit to the 512-byte stack buffer mn_text; it also uses the unchecked strstr results for "ccm=" and " " to compute l for memcpy into ccms, allowing out-of-bounds memory access.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2016-2464): In mkvparser::Match(), the id/size/len values returned by ReadUInt are checked only by assert() (no-ops in release), so an unvalidated size (negative or >8) or out-of-range len is used in UnserializeUInt(pReader, pos, size) and pos arithmetic, causing reads beyond the available data.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2016-6561): smb_flush_file() dereferences ofile->f_node->flags (and passes f_node to smb_fsop_commit) without checking for a NULL f_node, which is the case when the ofile is a named pipe, so a flush on a pipe crashes the kernel.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2015-3842): In the EFFECT_CMD_GET_PARAM case, memcpy(pReplyData, pCmdData, sizeof(effect_param_t) + p->psize) uses the attacker-controlled p->psize without checking it against cmdSize or *replySize, overflowing pReplyData (and over-reading pCmdData).

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance: In read_edge(), the file-supplied indices epr, ene, v and f are bounds-checked only by CGAL_assertion_msg (disabled in release builds) before indexing Edge_of, SVertex_of and SFace_of, allowing out-of-bounds reads.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (None): status() calls vsprintf(buf, fmt, args) into the fixed 1024-byte static buf without a length bound, so formatted output longer than 1024 bytes (e.g. from long user-supplied strings) overflows buf.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (None): message() writes msg (plus the strerror text) into the fixed 1024-byte stack buffer buf with sprintf/strcpy and no length limit, so a long msg overflows the stack.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2021-3514): In sync_create_state_control(), when the entry has no nsuniqueid attribute, attr/val from slapi_entry_attr_find()/slapi_attr_first_value() are used without a NULL check, so slapi_value_get_string(val) and sync_nsuniqueid2uuid() dereference NULL.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance: read_hedge() uses the file-supplied indices epr, ene, v and f to index Halfedge_of, Vertex_of and Face_of without a real bounds check, because the assertion uses || and is a no-op in release builds, giving an out-of-bounds read on malformed input.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance: In read_vertex(), the input-supplied index f is used to index Face_of[f] (isolated vertex) or Halfedge_of[f] without checking that 0 <= f < fn or f < en, causing an out-of-bounds read.

CWE-416: Use After Free
This instance (None): When mbedtls_calloc fails while enlarging cur->val.p for an existing entry, the function frees cur->oid.p and cur even though cur remains linked in the *head list, leaving a dangling node that is later used or freed again.

CWE-416: Use After Free
This instance: After htc_issue_send() hands skb off to the transport (which frees it on TX completion), htc_setup_complete() calls kfree_skb(skb) on the wait_for_completion_timeout timeout path, freeing an skb that is still in use/owned by the TX path (use-after-free/double free).

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance: data is malloc'd for 50 ints but memmove copies 100*sizeof(int) bytes from source into it, overflowing the heap buffer.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance: data is set to dataBuffer - 8 (before the start of the stack buffer), and strcpy(data, source) writes through it, underwriting memory before dataBuffer.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance: data is set to dataBuffer - 8 and the copy loop writes data[i] for i in 0..99, writing before the start of the stack buffer dataBuffer (buffer underwrite).

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance: data is set to dataBuffer - 8, so memmove(data, source, 100*sizeof(wchar_t)) writes before the start of the malloc'd heap buffer (buffer underwrite).

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance: memmove(dest, data, strlen(dest)) uses the 99-character length of the 100-byte dest as the copy size, reading past the end of the 50-byte heap buffer data.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance: data is set to dataBuffer - 8 (before the start of the allocated buffer) and strcpy(dest, data) reads from that out-of-bounds location (buffer underread).

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance: data is set to dataBuffer - 8, before the start of the alloca'd buffer, and wcsncpy(dest, data, wcslen(dest)) then reads from that out-of-bounds location (buffer under-read).

CWE-401: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime (memory leak)
This instance: The buffer allocated by wcsdup() into data in load_entry_33() is never freed before the function returns, leaking memory.

CWE-401: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime (memory leak)
This instance: The buffer `data` allocated via realloc in handle_request_15() is never freed (the second staticFive==5 block is empty), leaking memory when the function returns.

CWE-415: Double Free
This instance: In parse_input_49(), data is malloc'd and freed in the first block and the stale pointer is stored via dataPtr1, then freed a second time through dataPtr2 in the second block.

CWE-908: Use of Uninitialized Resource
This instance: The stack buffer `data` allocated via ALLOCA is never initialized (the init branch is empty), yet its elements' intOne and intTwo are read and printed in the loop.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2021-32269): In ilst_item_box_dump(), the DISK/TRKN/TMPO cases dereference itune->data->data and itune->data->dataSize in gf_bs_new() without checking that itune->data is non-NULL, which it is when the item box has no data child.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2021-39523): In check_POLYLINE_handles(), when the layer is shifted from vertex[0] and the next object is not a SEQEND, seqend->obj is dereferenced in dwg_next_object(seqend->obj) even though seqend (_obj->seqend) can be NULL.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2019-16164): myhtml_tree_node_remove() sets node->parent, node->prev and node->next to NULL before calling myhtml_tree_node_callback_remove(), so the callback works on a node with NULL parent/sibling links, leading to a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2018-21015): AVC_DuplicateConfig() dereferences its cfg parameter (cfg->AVCLevelIndication and the following fields) without checking for NULL, so a missing AVC config from a crafted file causes a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2018-7186): gplotRead() uses fscanf with an unbounded %s (Rootname, Commandfile name, Output file name) into the fixed-size stack buffer buf, so an overlong string in the gplot file overflows the stack.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2018-7186): ptaReadStream() calls fscanf with an unbounded "%s" into the 128-byte stack buffer typestr, so a long format string in the input file overflows the stack.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2022-4121): mailimap_mailbox_data_status_free() passes info->st_info_list to clist_foreach() and clist_free() without checking for NULL, so a STATUS response with no status info list causes a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2022-1620): In fname_match(), after the first vim_regexec() fails and leaves rmp->regprog NULL (invalid pattern), the function calls vim_regexec() again on the home-replaced name without checking rmp->regprog, causing a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2016-3863): convertMessageToMetaData() passes a fixed 1024-byte stack buffer avcc to reassembleAVCC(), which copies the attacker-sized csd-0 and csd-1 buffers into it without bounds, causing a stack buffer overflow.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2016-9423): formUpdateBuffer() passes spos/epos from the anchor to form_update_line() without checking that a->start.line == a->end.line and spos <= epos, so a crafted form anchor makes form_update_line overflow the line's heap buffers.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2015-8736): In mp2t_find_next_pcr(), the stack array buffer[MP2T_SIZE] receives MP2T_SIZE+trailer_len bytes from wtap_read_bytes_or_eof, so a non-zero trailer_len causes a stack buffer overflow.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2010-4242): hci_uart_tty_open() attaches the line discipline without checking that tty->ops->write is non-NULL, so a later transmit through tty->ops->write calls a NULL function pointer.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2011-0712): snd_usb_caiaq_audio_init() uses strcpy() to copy the USB-supplied dev->product_name into the fixed-size dev->pcm->name without bounding the length, so a long device name overflows the pcm name array.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2011-0712): snd_usb_caiaq_midi_init() uses strcpy to copy device->product_name, a USB-supplied name that can be longer than the destination, into the fixed-size rmidi->name array without a length bound, overflowing it.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2017-5957): The guest-controlled nr_cbufs is never bounded to 8, so the loop in vrend_decode_set_framebuffer_state() writes past the end of the 8-element stack array surf_handle[].

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2018-1000117): _is_absW() reads path[1] without first checking that path[0] is non-NUL, so an empty path string causes a read one element past its terminator.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2018-15862): In LookupModMask(), str returned by xkb_atom_text(ctx, field) may be NULL for an invalid atom, and it is passed to istreq() without a NULL check, causing a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2018-1000852): drdynvc_process_data_first() calls drdynvc_read_variable_uint() for ChannelId (cbChId) and Length (Sp) without checking Stream_GetRemainingLength(s), so a short server PDU causes a read past the end of the stream buffer.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2023-45897): The loop in read_file_dentry_set() iterates up to the on-disk file_de->file_num_ext without bounding it to MAX_NAME_DENTRIES, so memcpy into node->name + (i-2)*ENTRY_NAME_MAX writes past the end of the node->name buffer.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2023-27783): dlt_jnpr_ether_cleanup() calls tcpedit_dlt_cleanup(config->subctx) without checking that subctx is non-NULL, so the assert in tcpedit_dlt_cleanup aborts (or a NULL dereference occurs) when no sub-context was created.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2023-1390): tipc_link_xmit() calls buf_msg(skb_peek(list)) and then msg_importance(hdr)/msg_size(hdr) without first checking whether the list is empty, so an empty list (e.g. from tipc_named_node_up) causes a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2023-33461): In iniparser_getboolean() the return value c of iniparser_getstring() is checked only against INI_INVALID_KEY, not NULL, so c[0] dereferences a NULL pointer when getstring returns NULL.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2021-45266): In lsr_translate_anim_trans_values(), for the rotate transform with coded_type 8, f = gf_list_get(l, 0) can return NULL when the decoded value list is empty, and it is dereferenced unchecked in p->angle = *f.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2021-40574): In gf_text_process_sub(), the loop copying characters from szLine after '{' into the 20-byte stack buffer szTime has no length bound, so a long start-time field in a SUB line overflows szTime.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2022-0240): prepare_singleton_class() dereferences o->c (o->c->tt) without checking that o->c is non-NULL, crashing when called on an object whose class pointer is NULL.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2008-5025): hfs_cat_find_brec() copies rec.thread.CName.len bytes from the on-disk thread record into fd->search_key->cat.CName.name via memcpy without checking that len <= HFS_NAMELEN, overflowing the name buffer.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2009-2908): ecryptfs_unlink() calls vfs_unlink() on lower_dentry without taking a reference via dget(), so d_delete() turns the lower dentry negative (d_inode = NULL) while open files still use it, leading to a NULL d_inode dereference in later read/write/getxattr paths.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2009-3726): nfs4_proc_lock() passes ctx->state to nfs4_proc_getlk/nfs4_proc_unlck/nfs4_proc_setlk without checking it for NULL, so a file opened without NFSv4 state causes a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2023-40083): In StartAdvertisingSet() the GAP-data parsing loops take `len` from the advertise, scan-response and periodic data and copy `[begin, begin+len+1)` into a new vector without checking that `offset+len+1` fits within the source vector, so a malformed length reads beyond the buffer.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2023-40083): In StartAdvertising, the loops over advertise_data and scan_response_data compute end = begin + len + 1 from an untrusted length byte without checking it against the vector size, so constructing data_copy reads past the end of the buffer.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2023-42801): extractVersionQuadFromString() copies the server-controlled input string into the fixed 128-byte stack buffer versionString with an unbounded strcpy, so input of 128 bytes or more overflows the stack buffer.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2023-50471): cJSON_InsertItemInArray() dereferences newitem (newitem->next/newitem->prev) without a NULL check, and dereferences newitem->prev->next when after_inserted->prev is NULL for a non-child item, causing a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2020-27678): The loop in parse_user_name() copies characters from user_input into the fixed-size stack buffer username[PAM_MAX_RESP_SIZE] without checking index against PAM_MAX_RESP_SIZE, so an overlong user name overflows the stack buffer.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2020-28346): In vq_getchain(), the indirect-descriptor pointer vindir returned by paddr_guest2host() for a guest-controlled vdir->addr is dereferenced (vp = &vindir[next]; vp->flags) without a NULL check, and _vq_record() failures that leave iov_base NULL are ignored.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2021-31258): gf_isom_set_extraction_slc() dereferences the sample entry's esd->desc->slConfig chain without NULL checks, so a crafted file with a missing esds box, decoder descriptor or slConfig causes a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2022-47022): In hwloc_linux_get_tid_cpubind(), the result of CPU_ALLOC(kernel_nr_cpus) stored in plinux_set is not checked for NULL before being passed to sched_getaffinity() and dereferenced via CPU_ISSET_S().

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2022-47022): In hwloc_linux_set_tid_cpubind(), the return value of CPU_ALLOC(last+1) is not checked for NULL before plinux_set is used by CPU_ZERO_S/CPU_SET_S, causing a NULL pointer dereference on allocation failure.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2022-47022): In hwloc_linux_set_thread_cpubind(), plinux_set returned by CPU_ALLOC(last+1) is used by CPU_ZERO_S/CPU_SET_S without a NULL check, causing a NULL pointer dereference on allocation failure.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2012-2763): readstr_upto() writes g_unichar_to_utf8 output into sc->strbuff via p in a loop that stops only on a delimiter or NUL, never on the buffer size, so a long input string overflows the fixed-size strbuff.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2018-10753): delayed_output() points the global outbuf/mbf at a fixed 20*1024-byte stack array tmpbuf, while draw_sym_near()/a2b() write up to outbufsz bytes, so large delayed output overflows the stack buffer.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2020-1967): In tls1_check_sig_alg(), the result of tls1_lookup_sigalg() on a peer-supplied peer_cert_sigalgs[i] value is dereferenced (sigalg->sigandhash) without a NULL check, so an unrecognised signature algorithm from the peer causes a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-362: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition')
This instance (CVE-2020-11884): enable_sacf_uaccess() reads and loads control registers 1 and 7 and sets the CIF_ASCE_PRIMARY/SECONDARY flags without disabling interrupts, so a concurrent page table upgrade IPI (set_user_asce) can interleave and leave CR1/CR7 inconsistent.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2012-4233): In XclImpDrawObjBase::ReadObj8(), xDrawObj stays empty when the record is too short or the OBJCMO subrecord id/size check fails, yet xDrawObj->mnTab and xDrawObj->ImplReadObj8() are then called without a NULL check.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2023-21250): In gatt_end_operation()'s GATTC_OPTYPE_READ branch, memcpy copies p_clcb->counter bytes into the fixed-size stack buffer cb_data.att_value.value without checking that the length is at most GATT_MAX_ATTR_LEN, overflowing it.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2016-3119): In process_db_args(), the return value of strtok_r(db_args[i], "=", &arg_val) can be NULL for an empty DB argument and is passed unchecked to strcmp(arg, TKTPOLICY_ARG), causing a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2013-1798): In ioapic_read_indirect(), redir_index is derived from the guest-controlled ioapic->ioregsel and used to index ioapic->redirtbl[] with only a no-op ASSERT, allowing an out-of-bounds read past the redirection table.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2013-7339): In rds_ib_laddr_check(), cm_id->device is dereferenced (cm_id->device->node_type) after a successful rdma_bind_addr() without checking that it is non-NULL, though binding can leave the device NULL.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2015-6031): IGDstartelt() memcpy's the XML element name of length l into the fixed-size datas->cureltname and writes cureltname[l]='\0' without checking l against MINIUPNPC_URL_MAXSIZE, so an oversized element name overflows the buffer.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2014-9584): In the SIG('E','R') case, the loop prints rr->u.ER.data[p] for p < rr->u.ER.len_id without checking len_id against rr->len or the buffer size, reading kernel memory past the record.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2021-40574): In gf_text_get_utf8_line(), the conversion loop writes szLineConv[j] with no check against the 1024-byte stack buffer while non-UTF8 high-bit bytes expand to two output bytes, so long lines overflow szLineConv.

CWE-362: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition')
This instance (CVE-2022-3303): snd_pcm_oss_sync() calls snd_pcm_oss_make_ready() outside runtime->oss.params_lock and only takes the mutex afterwards, so a concurrent stream re-setup in that window leaves runtime->oss.buffer/params inconsistent (e.g. NULL) when they are used under the lock.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2019-15219): In sisusb_probe(), when usb_register_dev() fails, the error path calls dev_err(&sisusb->sisusb_dev->dev, ...) while sisusb->sisusb_dev is still NULL (from kzalloc), because it is only assigned after registration.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2019-19925): In zipfileUpdate(), zPath from sqlite3_value_text(apVal[2]) is NULL when the inserted name is NULL, and it is passed to strlen() and dereferenced (zPath[nPath-1]) without a NULL check.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2014-0144): curl_read_cb() does memcpy(s->orig_buf + s->buf_off, ptr, realsize) without checking realsize against the remaining space (s->buf_len - s->buf_off), so a server sending more data than requested overflows the orig_buf heap buffer.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2022-1620): In fname_match(), after the first vim_regexec() fails and can leave rmp->regprog NULL for an invalid pattern, the function calls vim_regexec() again on the home_replace_save() result without checking rmp->regprog, causing a NULL pointer dereference.

CWE-401: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime (memory leak)
This instance (CVE-2019-19082): In dcn10_create_resource_pool(), the kzalloc'd pool is not freed when construct() fails, so it leaks on the error path that returns NULL.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2018-25033): stl_remove_degenerate() calls stl_update_connects_remove_1() with neighbor2 or neighbor1 equal to -1 when both neighbors are -1, causing an out-of-bounds heap read of stl->neighbors_start[-1] in the callee.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2021-20297): nm_wildcard_match_check() passes a possibly-NULL str directly to fnmatch(p, str, 0), causing a NULL pointer dereference when the device's path or interface string is NULL.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2020-11089): drive_process_irp_write() reads the attacker-supplied Length from irp->input and passes Stream_Pointer(irp->input) with that Length to drive_file_write without checking that Length bytes remain in the stream, causing an out-of-bounds read.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2021-34552): In convert(), the unsupported-conversion error path uses unbounded sprintf to copy the caller-controlled mode (and imIn->mode) into the fixed 256-byte static buf, so an overly long mode string overflows the buffer.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2021-43389): detach_capi_ctr() reads capi_controller[ctr->cnr - 1] without checking that ctr->cnr is within 1..CAPI_MAXCONTR, so a never-attached controller (cnr 0) causes an out-of-bounds access at index -1.

CWE-362: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition')
This instance (CVE-2019-9637): In the cross-filesystem (EXDEV) path of php_plain_files_rename(), php_copy_file() creates url_to under the default umask and then calls VCWD_CHMOD before VCWD_CHOWN, leaving a window where the copied file is accessible with wrong permissions or group to other users.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2019-17133): cfg80211_mgd_wext_giwessid() calls memcpy(ssid, ie + 2, data->length) with data->length = ie[1] taken from the BSS SSID element without checking it against IW_ESSID_MAX_SIZE, overflowing the ssid buffer.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2016-3119): In process_db_args(), the return value of strtok_r(db_args[i], "=", &arg_val) can be NULL for an empty DB argument, and it is passed to strcmp(arg, TKTPOLICY_ARG) without a NULL check, dereferencing a null pointer.

CWE-401: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime (memory leak)
This instance (CVE-2019-19057): In mwifiex_pcie_init_evt_ring(), when mwifiex_map_pci_memory() fails the function returns -1 without freeing the just-allocated skb from dev_alloc_skb() (and card->evtbd_ring_vbase), leaking memory.

CWE-401: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime (memory leak)
This instance (CVE-2009-0031): In keyctl_join_session_keyring(), the buffer allocated by strndup_user() for name is never kfree'd after join_session_keyring() returns, leaking kernel memory on each call.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2009-1897): In tun_chr_poll(), tun->sk is read in the initializer of sk before the !tun check, so the NULL returned by __tun_get() for an unattached tun file is dereferenced (and the later check can be compiled away).

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2020-1967): In tls1_check_sig_alg(), the result of tls1_lookup_sigalg(s->s3.tmp.peer_cert_sigalgs[i]) can be NULL for an unrecognised peer signature algorithm, yet sigalg->sigandhash is dereferenced without a NULL check.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2017-13054): In lldp_private_8023_print(), the LLDP_PRIVATE_8023_SUBTYPE_MTU case reads EXTRACT_16BITS(tptr + 4) without checking that tlv_len >= 6, so a short TLV causes a buffer over-read.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2017-13038): handle_mlppp() calls EXTRACT_16BITS(p) and dereferences *p without checking length >= 2 or ND_TTEST_16BITS(p), so a truncated MLPPP packet causes a read beyond the captured buffer.

CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
This instance (CVE-2018-13006): hdlr_dump() calls strlen(p->nameUTF8+1), which reads past the end of the heap-allocated nameUTF8 buffer when the name is empty (first byte is the NUL terminator).

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference
This instance (CVE-2018-10074): In hi3660_stub_clk_probe(), the return value res of platform_get_resource() is not checked for NULL before res->start and resource_size(res) are used in the devm_ioremap() call.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2018-7186): gplotRead() calls fscanf with unbounded "%s" conversions (Rootname, Commandfile name, Output file name) into the fixed-size stack buffer buf, so a long string in the file overflows the stack buffer.

CWE-416: Use After Free
This instance (CVE-2013-2857): In updateFromElement(), when the image source attribute is empty but non-null, the error event is dispatched synchronously via m_element->dispatchEvent(), letting script run and destroy or modify the element/ImageLoader, after which the function continues using freed m_element/m_image/this.

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
This instance (CVE-2016-0807): get_build_id() checks nhdr.n_namesz instead of nhdr.n_descsz before calling backtrace->Read(addr, build_id_data, nhdr.n_descsz), so an attacker-controlled desc size overflows the 128-byte stack buffer build_id_data.

CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference

CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
